name: pyautogui_screen_screenshot
description:
Capture a screenshot of the full screen and save it as a PNG.

On WSLg, use `pyautogui_screen_screenshot_window` to capture a specific app window reliably (full-screen scrot captures the compositor buffer which may be black for some windows).

Returns the saved file path and image dimensions.

path.description: Output PNG path (defaults to a temp file)
